import numpy as np
import mujoco
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

class Controller:
    def __init__(self,s):
        self.s=s
        self.m=s.model
        self.site=s.env.robots[0].eef_site_id['right']
        self.jids=[self.m.joint(f'robot0_joint{i}').id for i in range(1,8)]
        self.qadr=self.m.jnt_qposadr[self.jids]
        self.limits=self.m.jnt_range[self.jids]
        self.scratch=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
        self.R=np.array([[0.,0.,1.],[0.,-1.,0.],[1.,0.,0.]])
    def ik(self,p,R=None,qseed=None):
        if R is None:R=self.R
        self.scratch.qpos[:]=self.s.data.qpos
        seed=self.s.data.qpos[self.qadr].copy() if qseed is None else qseed.copy()
        def fun(q):
            self.scratch.qpos[self.qadr]=q
            mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.scratch)
            xyz=self.scratch.site_xpos[self.site]
            rot=self.scratch.site_xmat[self.site].reshape(3,3)
            return np.r_[xyz-p,0.4*Rotation.from_matrix(R@rot.T).as_rotvec(),0.001*(q-seed)]
        res=least_squares(fun,seed,bounds=(self.limits[:,0]+1e-4,self.limits[:,1]-1e-4),xtol=1e-10,ftol=1e-10,gtol=1e-10,max_nfev=200)
        return res.x,np.linalg.norm(fun(res.x)[:3])
    def joints(self,q,steps=80,grip=1):
        start=self.s.data.qpos[self.qadr].copy()
        for t in range(steps):
            a=self.s.initial_command()
            u=min(1,(t+1)/(steps*.75)); u=u*u*(3-2*u)
            a[:7]=start*(1-u)+q*u
            a[7]=grip
            self.s.step(a)
    def move(self,p,steps=80,R=None,grip=1):
        q,err=self.ik(np.array(p),R)
        print('IK',np.round(q,4),'error',err,flush=True)
        self.joints(q,steps,grip)
        print('Actual',self.s.data.site_xpos[self.site], 'state',self.s.env.microwave.get_state(),'check',self.s.check()['success'],flush=True)
